clips.title: The story
paras: Attack on Camp Narache is a vital discovery made within the quilboar den of Brambleblade Ravine. A dirt-stained map reveals that the aggressive Bristleback tribe is actively plotting an organized siege against Camp Narache. Delivering these plans to Chief Hawkwind alerts Camp Narache in time to summon aid from Bloodhoof Village.

While scouting deep inside the caverns of Brambleblade Ravine, young tauren adventurers uncover a crude, dirt-stained map laying on the rock floor. Upon closer inspection, the parchment reveals deliberate tactical markings made by the Bristleback quilboar. Rather than engaging in mere opportunistic skirmishes, the quilboar are coordinating a full-scale, prolonged siege against Camp Narache.

Carrying the attack plans back to Camp Narache provides Chief Hawkwind with crucial intelligence. Recognizing the dire threat posed to the relatively undefended camp and its young initiates, Hawkwind prepares to send word to Bloodhoof Village for reinforcements. The intercepted map transforms what could have been a catastrophic ambush into a prepared defense.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.
Surely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have a look of concern about you, friend. What news do you bring?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many tauren, friend.
